title: AAPS crashes when applying the setting
symptom: Since a recent DEV build, AAPS is terminated immediately when going to Settings or pressing the Settings button. All other functions remain applicable. One user also reports the Eop2 beeping on profile changes.
cause: The crashes are traced to an outdated DEV build, specifically commit 7ad13882ef. MilosKozak states the data shown is only a build date, not the actual version, and that the issue is fixed in a newer commit.
fix: Upgrade to the latest DEV build.
evidence_quote: I see crashes comming from 7ad13882ef The data is only date of build, not version
